invariants.rationale: Padding values are often non-negative in layout contexts.
By method implementation and Javadoc, result sums padTop and padBottom paddings.
As the sum of two finite paddings, the result should also be finite.
Unless padBottom is negative and greater in magnitude than padTop, result is at least padTop.
Symmetric to padTop, result is at least padBottom unless padTop is negative and dominates.
